subject: Observability add-ons pricing: retention, tracing & dashboards — two scenarios
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Janelle Grant <janelle.grant@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons pricing: retention, tracing & dashboards — two scenarios

Hi Samir / Janelle,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about the Atlas Health roadmap for auditing and SRE signal coverage. Per our conversation I wanted to lay out two clean pricing scenarios for the observability add-ons (retention, tracing, advanced dashboards) so your procurement team can see tradeoffs quickly.

Scenario A (conservative):
- 30-day retained spans + 90-day metrics aggregation (default sampling)
- Full tracing ingestion (hot path) for 3 services, sampled at 10% beyond hot path
- Standard advanced dashboard pack (up to 10 named dashboards)
- Estimated USD 6k/month add-on; 12-month commit recommended

Scenario B (aggressive savings):
- 7-day retained full spans + 365-day metrics archive (cold storage)
- Tracing KV cache + compressed store for long tail (saves ~35% token cost)
- Seatless dashboard view + dashboard API access (no named dashboards)
- Estimated USD 3.8k/month add-on; 12-month commit with 6-month review

A few notes:
- We can mix elements (e.g., 30-day spans + seatless dashboards) if you prefer a hybrid.
- I'll attach a pro forma and an appendix showing the retention buckets by cost to make comparisons easier.

Next steps: if procurement wants a single pro forma we can lock scenario and give a 10% discounted first-quarter credit for an initial annual commit. If you'd like, I can loop in our pricing lead (Priyom) for a quick 30‑minute call later this week.

Best,
Camila
--
Camila Reyes

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons pricing: retention, tracing & dashboards — two scenarios

Camila — thanks for the clear scenarios. A few quick clarifying questions from our side:

1) For Scenario A, can you confirm whether the \"advanced dashboard pack\" includes alerting templates or just visualization panels? We need alerting tied to the audit traces.
2) Scenario B looks attractive cost-wise. Is there a practical impact on our SLA or query latency when using seatless dashboards + cold archive? Our infra team is worried about ad‑hoc queries on 365-day cold data.
3) We may be able to commit to a 12-month term but need a PO path that allows a one-time mid-year review. Any flexibility on credits if we hit 2x ingest unexpectedly?

Procurement asked for a single pro forma line item we can push through their e-Procurement system (they dislike multi-line bundles). Can you provide that?

Thanks —
Samir
Samir Patel
Director of Platform Engineering | Atlas Health

Camila / Marissa — drafted single-line pro forma and commercial language below (ready to attach as PDF). Happy to tweak.

Pro forma line (suggested):
"Redwood Observability Add-Ons: Retention (30d spans / 365d metrics archive optional), Tracing (hot path for 3 services + sampled long-tail), Advanced Dashboards (API + alert templates) — Annual Commitment — USD 72,000 (billed monthly at USD 6,000) — Includes: one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of first-quarter invoice. See appendix for retention bucket costs."

Fallback / concession language:
- Seatless dashboard option: USD 45,600 annually (billed monthly at USD 3,800) — reduced named dashboard capacity, query credits apply for deep historical queries.
- Overage protection: automatic usage credit of 15% applied to next invoice when monthly ingest exceeds 2x baseline for two consecutive months (does not apply to sustained contract breaches).

Operational note on latency: deep historical queries against the 365-day archive are routed to cold storage — expect +1 to +3 seconds median additional latency for ad-hoc heavy queries; dashboard API endpoints for recent data unaffected.

If we want a small commercial concession to close, I recommend offering an initial 8% net discount on the annualized seatless option in exchange for a signed PO within 10 business days.

- Option 1 (Recommended): Redwood Observability Add-Ons — USD 6,000/mo (annualized USD 72,000) — includes 30d span retention, 365d metrics archive for cold storage, hot-path tracing for 3 services, advanced dashboards with alert templates. 10% onboarding credit applied to first quarter.
- Option 2 (Cost-saver): Seatless dashboard alternative — USD 3,800/mo (annualized USD 45,600). Seatless removes named dashboards and adds query credits for deep historical queries.
- Overage protection: automatic 15% credit to next invoice when monthly ingest > 2x baseline for two consecutive months.
- Query latency note: deep historical queries on 365d cold archive may see +1–3s additional median latency; near-term data queries are unaffected.

I've attached the pro forma (single-line) and the retention appendix. If procurement confirms that the single-line format is acceptable, we can push the pro forma to your e-Procurement system and offer a 10% credit on the first quarter for a signed annual PO within 10 business days. Priyom has also indicated we can consider an 8% net concession on the seatless annualized option to accelerate signature.

Would you like a short call Wednesday to finalize language?
